name: Bobbinbound Meadow
mood: A nature-led plum-lace meadow of orchard birds, fern fronds, fungi, a clover hare and pollinators.
credits: Glaze original artwork, built-in OpenAI image generation; original native widget geometry by lane B.
prompt: ONE original1290x2796 portrait phone wallpaper for GLAZE BOBBINBOUND MEADOW, now a NATURE-LED meadow habitat. In the lower middle, a small thrush perches on an arched fruiting orchard bough, a wild hare crouches among broad clover leaves, three fern fronds unfold beside two woodland mushrooms, a dragonfly rests across reeds above a tiny pond opening, and a bumblebee approaches a tall curved foxglove spray. Each living subject has recognisable natural anatomy and strong different silhouette. One coherent organic meadow edge, no buildings, machines, vehicles, garden infrastructure or decorative doilies. Medium is HANDMADE DEEP-PLUM LINEN LACE: paired twisted/braided thread paths, thick bundled outline cords for readable silhouettes, small knotted joins, open diamond grounds, scalloped picot edge loops, matte linen fibres and tiny hand-tension variation. All animals, plants and habitat are actual flat unpadded handworked lace depictions, not natural leaf veins/coral, wire, grown material, crochet/plush, cut-applique cloth fill, paper or CGI sculptures. Deep plum #332536, soft thread highlights #705568, sparse undyed ivory bindings #F0DEC2 on warm apricot woven linen #E3C3A5. Keep upper50% completely quiet plain linen for dark icons. IMPORTANT CROP SAFETY: every complete bird/hare/fern/flower/dragonfly lies within central75% width and between50% and85% canvas height, including all ears, toes, wing tips and flower bells. Leave bottom12% quiet linen too, so1290x2796 AND750x1334 crops retain the whole natural composition. A single gently curving lace ground stem connects the habitat, no enclosing frame or rectangular patch. No words, lettering, numbers, labels, clocks/gauges/readings, date/battery/weather values, UI, logos, signatures, borders or mockup.
